paper_metadata.title: The effect of NiAl content on the microstructure and properties of CoCrFeNi – NiAl – Nb pseudo-ternary triple-phase hypoeutectic high-entropy alloys
paper_metadata.journal: Journal of Materials Research and Technology

evidence.quote: A series of triple-phase hypoeutectic high-entropy alloys (HEAs), designated as (CoCrFeNi)93-x(NiAl)xNb7 (where x = 8, 12, 16, 19, 22, 26, 32), were developed in the present experiments.
